parent_proposals.insert_text: The [Formal Limit dossier](../dossiers/formal-limit.md#experience-and-constructive-continuation) **compares** the abstraction/experience question with notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. An inspectable permission can be recorded while also determining which actions become possible; its place in the operative world exceeds the record considered alone. The Blind Spot’s admitted experiential critique retains its outstanding book-passage task. A26’s native constitutive argument remains Argued, and neither that source debt nor a successful structural inspection decides artificial phenomenality.
parent_proposals.insert_after: The direct [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the constitutive triad: **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.

An enlarged or revised system can achieve valid work without making these three operations identical. The native account retains the present act of enlargement as distinct from its represented content.

parent_proposals.insert_text: The [Formal Limit dossier](../dossiers/formal-limit.md#limit-and-recurring-gap) **compares** recurrent non-coincidence with limits whose formal permissions can change. Repairing an inconsistent collecting rule is a genuine achievement; the act making that repair still has conditions which a further account can represent. The recurrence here does not assert that every closed system is incomplete. It preserves the native act/content relation through successful enlargement while the particular mathematical witnesses retain their domains.
parent_proposals.insert_after: The Immutable Gap is the non-coincidence between a determination and its determining condition. Representing that condition makes another determination; the present act of representing has not become the object it presents. “Immutable” names the recurrence of this relation through enlargement. It does not mean that descriptions, instruments or lives remain unchanged.

parent_proposals.insert_text: The [Formal Limit dossier](../dossiers/formal-limit.md#eckhart-qualified-predication) **compares** the just-person example through a stated respect: considering a person insofar as just does not certify every act of that person. This qualified assertion differs from several uses referring to one focus, as producing health and indicating health do. Their conjunction belongs to the essay’s argument. Flasch’s indicated chapters and primary Eckhart passages retain their separate collation task; the operative distinction does not wait upon a newly invented quotation.
parent_proposals.insert_after: The health example must be walked through its relations. A person has health; a diet is called healthy insofar as it contributes to that health; a complexion is called healthy insofar as it indicates it. Producing and indicating are different operations. The three uses are intelligibly ordered without saying that the diet, complexion and person possess health in an identical way.

parent_proposals.insert_text: The [Formal Limit dossier](../dossiers/formal-limit.md#russell-formation-and-repair) **compares** two precise changes in the containing relation. Russell’s type restriction or bounded separation changes the permissions which generated contradiction. Cusa’s polygon comparison retains each finite approximation while distinguishing the circle and theological maximum under their own respects. A new containing account must identify which rule or relation changed and what valid work survived. The sources therefore sharpen this hinge without making contradiction itself a universal warrant.
parent_proposals.insert_after: Paradox names a contradiction or irresolvable tension whose determinations have genuine standing and whose resolution can require the containing field to change. The initial task is to recover each proposition, its operation and its register. A false attribution or invalid inference must be corrected before their collision is treated as productive paradox.

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../../../symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **returns-to** the authorial relation carried through A03 and A23: investigation makes determinations; faith consciously continues through their non-exhaustion of ground. Its whole four-line movement remains available as a contemplation object. Each historical response in this Movement retains its own method and warrant.
**Mathematical anchor:** undecidability under stated formal conditions. **Images:** the ladder, the re-entering mark, the polygon approaching the circle, the sphere with centre everywhere and circumference nowhere. The positive response is [[05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity|§0/1 · #4 — Gebserian Diaphaneity]].
parent_proposals.insert_text: The [Formal Limit dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md) **historicises** the genealogy through distinct consequences: Russell restricts formation, Gödel bounds derivability within a stated theory, and the early Wittgenstein distinguishes saying and showing. The later practice inquiry keeps its separate work identity. Cusa’s theological precision and Eckhart’s qualified predication retain their own objects; their conjunction gives the next inquiry more exact permissions and responsibilities without making the histories one theorem.
